title: GUNNPOD PLUS – 4500 PUFFS – 50 PACK
description:
You can request flavours at checkout in the “order notes” section.

Flavours:
Cherry Pomegranate Ice
Classic Tobacco
Cola Ice
Cool Mint
Grape Ice
Lush Ice
Mando Rita
Mixed Berry
Pineapple Guava
Raspberry Lemon
Strawberry Kiwi
Strawberry Lush

Introducing the GUNNPOD PLUS Disposable Vape – a chilling and invigorating blend that delivers a refreshing burst of icy delight. This flavor offers an exhilarating vaping experience, combining a revitalizing menthol kick with a hint of sweetness. Relish the cool and crisp sensation with every puff of this premium disposable vape. Meticulously crafted for those who crave a brisk and revitalizing vape, GUNNPOD PLUS Lush Ice is a frosty, flavor-filled journey that leaves you with a gratifying, icy coolness in every inhalation. Experience the refreshing chill of Lush Ice with GUNNPOD PLUS.

Features:
– 12ML of E-liquid
– 4500 Puffs per Device
– Air Flow Control
– Type-C Rechargeable
– Integrated 1400mAh Battery
– Over Inhale and Short Circuit Protection
